lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular 2D grid of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in parallel horizontal rows along the mid-flank, posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like anchor node pattern across the mid-to-posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single continuous horizontal ridge feature located in the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a high-luminance superior edge and a shadowed inferior edge.
